page_title: MAI 0-1 HEI | Mainz v Heidenheim 16/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' That will be all from Lennard Maloney who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim).
90+3' Bastian Dankert shows a yellow card to Brajan Gruda (Mainz) for his blatant foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' The attendance is 27200.
86' Jan Siewert has decided to substitute Marco Richter and he is replaced by Aymen Barkok (Mainz).
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Danny da Costa as he is replaced by David Mamutovic (Mainz).
83' Foul! Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
82' An attempted cross from Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) is cleared.
76' Frank Schmidt has decided to make a change. Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) replaces Eren Dinkci.
75' Substitution. Jan-Niklas Beste will be replaced by Florian Pick (Heidenheim).

75' Marcus Muller (Mainz) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball low towards the middle of the goal. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Kevin Muller with a fabulous save.
74' Marco Richter (Mainz) will take the corner.
73' Substitution. Merveille Papela makes way for Marcus Muller (Mainz).
69' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Marvin Pieringer will be replaced by Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim).
68' Marco Richter (Mainz) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
66' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
64' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mainz, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) comes onto the pitch for Jonathan Burkardt.
62' The corner from Marco Richter (Mainz) is hurriedly cleared.

61' What a great touch by Marco Richter (Mainz) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Mainz win a corner.
59' Heidenheim fail to score from a corner as Daniel Batz (Mainz) leaps to collect the ball.
57' Yellow card. Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

56' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Heidenheim are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
54' Good work from Mainz as they win a corner.
53' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Marco Richter (Mainz) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.
51' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) plants a goal-bound header towards the bottom right corner after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders manages to deflect it away.
48' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
46' Jan Siewert makes a half-time substitution. Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) comes on in place of Tom Krauss.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) was quite harsh and Bastian Dankert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
43' Merveille Papela (Mainz) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
41' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Tom Krauss (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastian Dankert had an easy-decision to make.
35' Marco Richter (Mainz) sends in a cross from the free-kick from the edge of the box. His effort is inaccurate and goes out of play.
34' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
33' The possession of the ball – 66:34.
32' The corner from Marco Richter (Mainz) is intercepted by Kevin Muller.

32' Marco Richter (Mainz) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the top of the net. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Kevin Muller produces an easy save. Mainz earn a corner.
30' Marco Richter (Mainz) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
30' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

25' Merveille Papela (Mainz) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the top right corner, but Kevin Muller thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
23' PENALTY APPEAL after Brajan Gruda (Mainz) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
22' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) meets a cross inside the box, but Kevin Muller wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
21' Marco Richter (Mainz) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
21' It seemed like Brajan Gruda (Mainz) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
21' A clumsy foul by Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle.
18' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mainz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) jumps into a tackle and Bastian Dankert signals a foul.
16' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
16' Marco Richter (Mainz) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
12' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Benedikt Gimber picks out Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) with a sweet pass, and he latches on to it deep inside the box and beats the goalkeeper. 0:1.
10' A pass by Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

9' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Bastian Dankert blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
7' Danny da Costa (Mainz) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
5' Danny da Costa (Mainz) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
4' Wonderful movement by Mainz. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Heidenheim will take the kick-off.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Bastian Dankert.
